## The reading

The `spec-property-retirement` playbook's consumer walk rebuilds the dependency closure per walk: on the spec seat's 2026-09-05 shift each lap cost about six minutes on the shared box (measured on one retirement card). ## What

The playbook's walk rule names the affected-scoped form as the walk's default and keeps the full closure as the fallback when the affected set cannot be computed (a shallow clone, a missing merge base).
